scientific_integrity: Complete conditional-covariance and CRT proof is supplied. Finite upper-set verification is corroboration only. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform units and coordinatewise divisor order only; no classification for nonuniform or nonunit residues. General negative-association closure is classical, and the opposite-shift mixed moment is covered prior art. Relevant but unlocated work could contain an equivalent arithmetic classification.
title: An exact arithmetic criterion for negative association of shifted gcds
